internal.title: Incident Resolved: Elevated Error Rates in Checkout and Payment Services
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 11:08 UTC, an alert was triggered due to high error rates in the checkout service. Initial diagnosis identified error injections in the checkout, payment, and frontend services. After ruling out the checkout service's cartFailure flag as a cause, the team focused on the payment service. The paymentFailure flag was disabled at 11:28 UTC, which led to recovery and normalization of error rates. The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on customer transactions.

Key actions taken:
- Diagnosis rounds identified error injections in multiple services.
- Disabled paymentFailure flag after approval.
- Verified recovery and monitored service stability.

This incident highlights the importance of coordinated flag management and rapid diagnosis in multi-service error scenarios.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to service errors
external.body: Between 11:08 and 11:28 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues completing their checkout due to elevated error rates in our payment processing system. Our engineering team identified and resolved the issue promptly by adjusting system configurations. The service is now stable, and all checkout operations are functioning normally. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
